title: Anthropic登陆华尔街 首日估值重定引关注
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: And Thropic has made its Wall Street debut, and investors gave the first publicly traded frontier AI lab a strong if volatile welcome. Shares opened 34% above the $83 IPO price and surged
segments.zh: Anthropic 登陆华尔街，市场参与者对这家首家上市的前沿 AI 实验室报以热烈但波动的欢迎。开盘价较 83 美元的发行价高出 34%，随后飙升

segments.en: as high as $115.10 before pulling back to close the day up 17%. In less than six years, and Thropic has gone from a start-up to one of the most valuable publicly traded companies
segments.zh: 一度触及 115.10 美元，随后回落，收盘上涨 17%。不到六年时间，Anthropic 从初创公司成长为全球最具价值的上市公司之一

segments.en: on the planet. That marks a strong first session, though, still a smaller day one pop than SpaceX managed in June. The money's already in the bank, $81.3 billion from the IPO,
segments.zh: 这标志着强劲的首日表现，不过首日涨幅仍小于 SpaceX 在 6 月的表现。资金已经落袋，IPO 募资 813 亿美元，

segments.en: and another $26 billion from strategic investors. Today was the real-time test of how public markets
segments.zh: 另有 260 亿美元来自战略市场参与者。今天是公开市场对 Anthropic 进行实时定价的考验

segments.en: would value and Thropic. And the demand was extraordinary, orders ran nearly seven times the shares available, leaving more than half of institutional bidders empty-handed and disappointed.
segments.zh: 需求异常旺盛，订单量接近可售股份的七倍，超过半数机构竞标者空手而归，失望不已。

segments.en: So now come the harder questions, right? Can Thropic grow fast enough to justify its enormous compute commitments? Can it turn that spending into durable profits and can a company built
segments.zh: 那么现在更棘手的问题来了：Anthropic 能否增长得足够快，以支撑其庞大的算力投入？能否将支出转化为持久利润？一家以 AI 安全和公共利益为宗旨的公司，

segments.en: around AI safety and public benefit hold onto those principles when Wall Street is watching every single quarter and wants to see returns? The IPO is done. Public company life starts now.
segments.zh: 在华尔街紧盯每一季度、要求看到回报的情况下，能否坚守这些原则？IPO 已经完成，上市公司生涯现在开始。
